title: PersianMedQA: Evaluating Large Language Models on a Persian-English Bilingual Medical Question Answering Benchmark
reasoning: The PersianMedQA benchmark specifically includes 'Medical Ethics' as one of its 23 evaluated medical specialties. The paper features a dedicated analysis in Section 4.3 ('Answer-Only Evaluation of LLM Medical Reasoning') that evaluates how models reason through ethical principles such as patient autonomy, informed consent, and professional disclosure.
